name: Saeima
notes: 100 seats, 15th Saeima (2026-2030), which met for the first time on 3 Nov 2026 and confirmed all 100 mandates. Seats by list as elected, from the Central Election Commission's results as reported by LVportals (provisional count of 4 Oct 2026; United List 41, Latvia First 17, Sovereign Power / Jaunlatvieši 15, National Alliance 10, Progressives 10, New Unity 7). saeima.lv's member pages for the new term could not be read from scripts (401), so factions, which form after the opening, are not shown. The United List is the joint list of the Greens, the Regions Alliance and Liepāja Party. No register supporter sits in the Saeima, so the chart is unlit.
